svg.title: Agentic Loop: state transitions and external stop
svg.desc: Repeated labels denote the same state. State transitions are separated into normal flow, human review, policy stop, recovery, and external stop cases.
svg.text: E. Common stop handling (any active state except ROLLBACK)

g.data-guard: budget/policy stop + stopping verified, effects known, no compensation

svg.text: budget / policy stop; verified, effects known, no compensation

g.data-guard: authorized fallback result ready; no compensation needed

svg.text: authorized fallback result ready; no compensation needed

svg.text: no acceptable fallback; stopping verified; effects known; no compensation

g.data-guard: outcome unknown or human judgment required

svg.text: outcome unknown or human judgment required

svg.text: compensation required, effects known, authorized and executable

g.data-guard: compensation failed or unknown, unsafe, or human judgment required

svg.text: compensation failed or unknown, unsafe, or human judgment required

g.data-guard: stop accepted; stopping verified; effects known; no compensation needed

svg.text: stop accepted; stopping verified; effects known; no compensation needed

g.data-guard: stop accepted; stopping verified; effects known; compensation required, authorized and executable

svg.text: stop accepted; stopping verified; effects known; compensation required, authorized and executable

g.data-guard: stop accepted; stop or effect unknown, unavailable compensation, or human judgment required

svg.text: stop accepted; stop or effect unknown, unavailable compensation, or human judgment required
Unconfirmed execution or effects follow the common stop handling below.
On accepted external, budget or policy stop: halt ordinary work; propagate Cancel to L5 / child executions.
Record request, delivery, acknowledgement and confirmed completion separately.
Fallback failure or an unverified result-origin binding starts policy stop; ordinary repair remains closed.
Pending: block ordinary transitions. Acknowledgement or timeout alone is not proof of stopping.
During ROLLBACK use panel D; if compensation cannot safely continue, escalate.
ESCALATED does not prove that an external execution has stopped. No automatic Human approval.
Repeated labels denote the same state. ANY_ACTIVE is shorthand, not a state. Terminals: COMPLETED / STOPPED / ESCALATED.
